✦ SPIRALSIGHTED MARKS · sigils & specimens ✦
from SpiralSightedVisions

WHAT'S IN THE PACK
  · SpiralSighted-Marks-Letter.pdf — 2 sticker sheets, US Letter
  · SpiralSighted-Marks-A4.pdf    — the same sheets, A4
  · png/ — all 12 stickers as transparent PNGs

PRINTING & CUTTING
  · Print at 100% on full-sheet sticker paper (matte or vinyl).
  · Cut along the white borders — scissors are fine, the wobble is the point.
  · Machine cutting: import the PNGs, print-and-cut with an offset of 0
    (the white die-cut border is already drawn in).
  · Digital planners: drop the PNGs straight into GoodNotes / Notability.

YOUR LICENSE
  Personal use: print and cut as many as you like, forever, for you and
  for gifts. Please don't resell or redistribute the files.

The frog has seen it. Trust the spiral. ✦
